package.author: Autodesk, Inc.
package.description: A sign-in component that works with versions 2020 and later of Autodesk software.

en-US.author: Autodesk, Inc.
en-US.description: A sign-in component that works with versions 2020 and later of Autodesk software.
en-US.longDescription: The Autodesk Single Sign On Component (AdSSO) provides the sign-in experience for versions 2020 and later of Autodesk software. The component is backward compatible with older Autodesk product releases, and Autodesk recommends always installing the latest available version for better security and performance.
en-US.name: Autodesk Single Sign On Component
